operator_update: C20 desoldered; short remains on PCB
interpretation: C20 is not the sole source if it is electrically isolated and the low-ohm SD-to-GND path remains. This does not yet distinguish IPM SD internal path from PCB/solder bridge.
required_state: STEVAL remains unpowered, ribbon and TP23 diagnostic lead disconnected; do not energize with C20 missing
next_separation: If clear visual inspection finds no bridge, disconnect only IPM pin14SD from its PCB pad while unpowered. Separately compare free pin14-to-pin16GND against PCB TP23-to-TP21. Do not infer chip failure from an in-circuit reading alone.
